title: Adi-khanda, part 4 (portion 12)
html:
Balya-lila (continued): by Gaura's touch the puppy gains divine knowledge and departs for Goloka in a celestial chariot, while the gods praise Gaura's mercy; Nimai eats the offering Shachi has prepared for the goddess Shashthi and teaches her that worship of Achyuta is the worship of all the gods; Nimai mimics Murari Gupta expounding yoga and instructs him in bhakti

গৌরাঙ্গ-পরশে কুক্কুর ভাগ্যবান ।
স্বভাব ছাড়ি তার হইল দিব্যজ্ঞান ॥ ৩২৪ ॥

gaurāṅga-paraśe kukkura bhāgyabāna |
sbabhāba chāṛi tāra haila dibyajñāna || 324 ||

gauranga-parashe — by Gauranga's touch; kukkura bhagyavana — the puppy became fortunate; svabhava chhadi — giving up its nature; tara haila divya-jnana — it gained divine knowledge

324By the touch of Gauranga the puppy became fortunate:
giving up its nature, it gained divine knowledge.1

রাধাকৃষ্ণ গোবিন্দ বলিয়া ডাকে নাচে ।
নদীয়ার লোক দেখি সব ধায় পাছে ॥ ৩২৫ ॥

rādhākṛṣṇa gobinda baliẏā ḍāke nāce |
nadīẏāra loka dekhi saba dhāẏa pāche || 325 ||

radhakrishna govinda baliya dake — cries "Radha-Krishna, Govinda"; nache — dances; nadiyara loka dekhi — seeing, the people of Nadiya; saba dhaya pachhe — all run after

325It cries "Radha-Krishna, Govinda!" and dances;
seeing it, all the people of Nadia run after it.

কুক্কুরের আবেশ এমন সভে দেখি ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ অশ্রুময় আঁখি ॥ ৩২৬ ॥

kukkurera ābeśa emana sabhe dekhi |
pulakita saba aṅga aśrumaẏa āṁkhi || 326 ||

kukkurera avesha emana — such rapture of the puppy; sabhe dekhi — all seeing; pulakita saba anga — all limbs thrill; ashrumaya ankhi — eyes full of tears

326Seeing such rapture in the puppy,
all thrill with ecstasy, their eyes full of tears.

আচম্বিতে শ্বান-দেহ ছাড়ি ভাগ্যবান ।
কৃষ্ণলোক হঞা করে গোলোকে পয়ান ॥ ৩২৭ ॥

ācambite śbāna-deha chāṛi bhāgyabāna |
kṛṣṇaloka hañā kare goloke paẏāna || 327 ||

achambite — suddenly; shvana-deha chhadi — leaving the dog's body; bhagyavana — the fortunate one; krishnaloka hana — becoming a dweller of Krishna's realm; kare goloke payana — sets out for Goloka

327Suddenly the fortunate one left its dog's body
and, becoming a dweller of Krishna's realm, set out for Goloka.

আচম্বিতে দিব্য এক রথ যে আসিয়া ।
আকাশের পথে যায় তাহারে লইয়া ॥ ৩২৮ ॥

ācambite dibya eka ratha ye āsiẏā |
ākāśera pathe yāẏa tāhāre laiẏā || 328 ||

achambite — all at once; divya eka ratha ye asiya — a divine chariot coming; akashera pathe yaya — goes along the path of the sky; tahare laiya — taking him

328All at once a divine chariot appeared
and carries him away along the path of the sky.

সুবর্ণের রথ চারু সহস্র-শিখর ।
মণি-মুকুতার ঝারা করে ঝলমল ॥ ৩২৯ ॥

subarṇera ratha cāru sahasra-śikhara |
maṇi-mukutāra jhārā kare jhalamala || 329 ||

suvarnera ratha — a golden chariot; charu — beautiful; sahasra-shikhara — with a thousand pinnacles; mani-mukutara jhara — pendants of jewels and pearls; kare jhalamala — glitter

329A golden chariot, beautiful, with a thousand pinnacles,
glitters with pendants of jewels and pearls.

লক্ষ লক্ষ ঘণ্টাধ্বনি হইছে তাহাতে ।
কাংস্য-করতাল তাথে বাজে যূথে যূথে ॥ ৩৩০ ॥

lakṣa lakṣa ghaṇṭādhbani haiche tāhāte |
kāṃsya-karatāla tāthe bāje yūthe yūthe || 330 ||

laksha laksha ghanta-dhvani — the ringing of hundreds of thousands of bells; haichhe tahate — sounds on it; kamsya-karatala — bronze cymbals; tathe baje yuthe yuthe — sound there in crowds

330Hundreds of thousands of bells ring on it,
bronze cymbals sound in crowds.

শঙ্খধ্বনি জয়ধ্বনি হরিধ্বনি শুনি ।
গন্ধর্ব-কিন্নর গায় রাধাকৃষ্ণ-বাণী ॥ ৩৪০ ॥

śaṅkhadhbani jaẏadhbani haridhbani śuni |
gandharba-kinnara gāẏa rādhākṛṣṇa-bāṇī || 340 ||

shankha-dhvani — the sound of conches; jaya-dhvani — cries of "jaya"; hari-dhvani shuni — cries of "Hari" are heard; gandharva-kinnara gaya — gandharvas and kinnaras sing; radhakrishna-vani — words of Radha and Krishna

340The sound of conches is heard, cries of "Jaya!" and "Hari!";2
gandharvas and kinnaras sing of Radha and Krishna.

ধ্বজ-পতাকা সব উড়ে রথোপরে ।
সূর্যের মণ্ডল ঢাকে কিরণ-উজোরে ॥ ৩৪১ ॥

dhbaja-patākā saba uṛe rathopare |
sūryera maṇḍala ḍhāke kiraṇa-ujore || 341 ||

dhvaja-pataka saba ude — all the banners and pennants fly; rathopare — above the chariot; suryera mandala dhake — cover the disc of the sun; kirana-ujore — with the brightness of their rays

341Banners and pennants all fly above the chariot;
their shining radiance eclipses the disc of the sun.

রথ-মধ্যস্থানে বসি রত্নসিংহাসনে ।
কমনীয়-কান্তি তেঁহো অতি মনোরমে ॥ ৩৪২ ॥

ratha-madhyasthāne basi ratnasiṃhāsane |
kamanīẏa-kānti teṁho ati manorame || 342 ||

ratha-madhyasthane — in the middle of the chariot; vasi ratna-simhasane — seated on a jewelled throne; kamaniya-kanti — of lovely lustre; tenho ati manorame — he, most enchanting

342In the middle of the chariot, on a jewelled throne,
sits he, lovely, of enchanting lustre.

দিব্য আভরণ তার অঙ্গে অঙ্গে সাজে ।
কোটি কোটি মদন মূর্চ্ছিত হয় লাজে ॥ ৩৪৩ ॥

dibya ābharaṇa tāra aṅge aṅge sāje |
koṭi koṭi madana mūrcchita haẏa lāje || 343 ||

divya abharana tara — his divine ornaments; ange ange saje — adorn every limb; koti koti madana — millions of Madanas; murchchhita haya laje — swoon with shame

343Divine ornaments adorn every limb;
millions of Madanas swoon with shame.

পরম-শীতল হৈল কোটিচন্দ্র জিনি ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া করে ধ্বনি ॥ ৩৪৪ ॥

parama-śītala haila koṭicandra jini |
rādhākṛṣṇa gaurāṅga baliẏā kare dhbani || 344 ||

parama-shitala haila — became supremely cool; koti-chandra jini — surpassing millions of moons; radhakrishna gauranga baliya — saying "Radha-Krishna, Gauranga"; kare dhvani — cries out

344Cool, surpassing millions of moons,
he cries out: "Radha-Krishna! Gauranga!"

সিদ্ধগণ সঙ্গে আসি চামর করিয়া ।
চলিলা গোলোক-পথে তাহারে লইয়া ॥ ৩৪৫ ॥

siddhagaṇa saṅge āsi cāmara kariẏā |
calilā goloka-pathe tāhāre laiẏā || 345 ||

siddhagana sange asi — the siddhas coming along; chamara kariya — fanning with chamaras; chalila goloka-pathe — went along the path to Goloka; tahare laiya — taking him

345The siddhas came, fanning [him] with chamaras,
and bore him along the path to Goloka.

ব্রহ্মা-শিব-সনকাদি সভে কর জুড়ি ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-মহিমা গান সভে রথ বেড়ি ॥ ৩৪৬ ॥

brahmā-śiba-sanakādi sabhe kara juṛi |
gaurāṅga-mahimā gāna sabhe ratha beṛi || 346 ||

brahma-shiva-sanakadi — Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and others; sabhe kara judi — all with joined palms; gauranga-mahima gana — sing Gauranga's glory; sabhe ratha bedi — all surrounding the chariot

346Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and the others, all with joined palms,
surrounding the chariot, sing the glory of Gauranga:

জয় জয় কৃপাসিন্ধু শচীর নন্দন ।
এমন করুণা প্রভু না কৈল কখন ॥ ৩৪৭ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa kṛpāsindhu śacīra nandana |
emana karuṇā prabhu nā kaila kakhana || 347 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; kripasindhu shachira nandana — to the ocean of mercy, Shachi's son; emana karuna — such mercy; prabhu na kaila kakhana — the Lord never showed

347"Glory, glory to the ocean of mercy, the son of Shachi!
Never has the Lord shown such mercy!

কুক্কুর উদ্ধার করি গোলোকে পাঠায় ।
দিব্য দেহ হেন কভু কেহো নাহি পায় ॥ ৩৪৮ ॥

kukkura uddhāra kari goloke pāṭhāẏa |
dibya deha hena kabhu keho nāhi pāẏa || 348 ||

kukkura uddhara kari — delivering a dog; goloke pathaya — sends to Goloka; divya deha hena — such a divine body; kabhu keho nahi paya — no one ever attains

348He delivered a dog and sent it to Goloka —
no one has ever attained such a divine body!

জয় জয় অগতির গতি গৌরহরি ।
জয় জয় অবতার সভার উপরি ॥ ৩৪৯ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa agatira gati gaurahari |
jaẏa jaẏa abatāra sabhāra upari || 349 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; agatira gati gaurahari — to Gaurahari, the refuge of the helpless; jaya jaya — glory, glory; avatara sabhara upari — above all avataras

349Glory, glory to Gaurahari, the refuge of the helpless!
Glory, glory to Him who is above all avataras!

তোর করুণায় কলি-জীব নিস্তারিব ।
আর কিবা লীলা তোর অলৌকিক হব ॥ ৩৫০ ॥

tora karuṇāẏa kali-jība nistāriba |
āra kibā līlā tora alaukika haba || 350 ||

tora karunay — by Your mercy; kali-jiva nistariba — the souls of Kali will be delivered; ara kiba lila tora — what further pastimes of Yours; alaukika haba — will be superhuman

350By Your mercy the souls of Kali will be delivered;
what superhuman pastimes will You not show!

মোরা-সব দেব কবে হব ভাগ্যবান ।
পাইব তোমার পদ-প্রসাদ প্রধান ॥ ৩৫১ ॥

morā-saba deba kabe haba bhāgyabāna |
pāiba tomāra pada-prasāda pradhāna || 351 ||

mora-saba deva — we gods all; kabe haba bhagyavana — when shall we become fortunate; paiba — shall we gain; tomara pada-prasada pradhana — the supreme grace of Your feet

351When shall we gods become fortunate
and gain the supreme gift — the grace of Your feet?

কুক্কুর তরিয়া যায় তোমার পরশে ।
এমন করুণা কভু নাহি হৃষীকেশে ॥ ৩৫২ ॥

kukkura tariẏā yāẏa tomāra paraśe |
emana karuṇā kabhu nāhi hṛṣīkeśe || 352 ||

kukkura tariya yaya — a dog is delivered; tomara parashe — by Your touch; emana karuna — such mercy; kabhu nahi hrishikeshe — was never in Hrishikesha

352By Your touch even a dog is delivered —
such mercy was never found even in Hrishikesha!3

কবে মোরা হইব এমন ভাগ্যভাগী ।
কুক্কুরে কৃতার্থ কৈলে তাই মোরা মাগি ॥ ৩৫৩ ॥

kabe morā haiba emana bhāgyabhāgī |
kukkure kṛtārtha kaile tāi morā māgi || 353 ||

kabe mora haiba — when shall we become; emana bhagya-bhagi — sharers in such fortune; kukkure kritartha kaile — You fulfilled a dog; tai mora magi — that we beg

353When shall we too have such good fortune?
You blessed a dog — that same we beg for ourselves.

নমো নমঃ অদোষ-দরশী গৌররায় ।
নমো নমঃ তোমার সুন্দর দুই পায় ॥ ৩৫৪ ॥

namo namaḥ adoṣa-daraśī gaurarāẏa |
namo namaḥ tomāra sundara dui pāẏa || 354 ||

namo namah — obeisance, obeisance; adosha-darashi gauraraya — to Gauraraya, who sees no faults; namo namah — obeisance, obeisance; tomara sundara dui paya — to Your two beautiful feet

354Obeisance, obeisance to Gauraraya, who sees no faults!
Obeisance, obeisance to Your two beautiful feet!"

অনুব্রজি হেনরূপে সব দেবগণ ।
কবে মোরা পাব গৌরচন্দ্রের চরণ ॥ ৩৫৫ ॥

anubraji henarūpe saba debagaṇa |
kabe morā pāba gauracandrera caraṇa || 355 ||

anuvraji — following [the chariot]; hena-rupe — thus; saba devagana — all the gods; kabe mora paba — when shall we attain; gaurachandrera charana — the feet of Gaurachandra

355So, following [the chariot], all the gods [pray]:
"When shall we attain the feet of Gaurachandra?"

এথা গোলোকেরে আইলা মহাভাগ্যবান ।
গৌরাঙ্গের লীলা অনুব্রত তথা গান ॥ ৩৫৬ ॥

ethā golokere āilā mahābhāgyabāna |
gaurāṅgera līlā anubrata tathā gāna || 356 ||

etha — and now; golokere aila — arrived in Goloka; mahabhagyavana — the greatly fortunate one; gaurangera lila — Gauranga's pastimes; anuvrata tatha gana — there constantly sings

356And that greatly fortunate one arrived in Goloka
and there ceaselessly sings of Gauranga's pastimes.

হেন অদ্ভুত গোরাচান্দের প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দে কহয়ে গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৩৫৭ ॥

hena adbhuta gorācāndera prakāśa |
ānande kahaẏe guṇa e locanadāsa || 357 ||

hena adbhuta — such a wondrous; gorachandera prakasha — manifestation of Gorachand; anande kahaye guna — in bliss tells [His] virtues; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

357Such is the wondrous manifestation of Gorachand —
in bliss this Lochana Dasa sings [His] virtues.

এথা শচীদেবী, মনে অনুভাবি,
ষষ্ঠীব্রত করিবারে ।
পুরনারী যত, সভে করি ব্রত,
গিয়া বটবৃক্ষতলে ॥ ৩৫৮ ॥

ethā śacīdebī, mane anubhābi,
ṣaṣṭhībrata karibāre |
puranārī yata, sabhe kari brata,
giẏā baṭabṛkṣatale || 358 ||

etha shachidevi — now Shachi-devi; mane anubhavi — resolving in her mind; shashthi-vrata karibare — to keep the vow of Shashthi; puranari yata — all the women of the town; sabhe kari vrata — all keeping the vow; giya vata-vriksha-tale — going under the banyan tree

358Now Shachi-devi resolved
to keep the vow of Shashthi:4
all the women of the town, keeping the vow,
[gathered] under the banyan tree.

নৈবেদ্যের সজ্জ, করিয়া সুসজ্জ,
আঁচলে ঢাকিয়া লঞা ।
ব্রত করিবারে, যায় বটতলে,
অতি হরষিত হঞা ॥ ৩৫৯ ॥

naibedyera sajja, kariẏā susajja,
āṁcale ḍhākiẏā lañā |
brata karibāre, yāẏa baṭatale,
ati haraṣita hañā || 359 ||

naivedyera sajja — the offering; kariya susajja — preparing properly; anchale dhakiya lana — covering it with the end of her sari; vrata karibare — to keep the vow; yaya vatatale — goes to the banyan; ati harashita hana — very joyfully

359Having properly prepared the offering (naivedya)
and covering it with the end of her sari,
she goes to the banyan to keep the vow,
in great joy.

হেনই সময়, বিশ্বম্ভর রায়,
খেলিতে খেলিতে পথে ।
জননী দেখিয়া, আইল ধাইয়া,
কি লইয়া যাও হাতে ॥ ৩৬০ ॥

henai samaẏa, biśbambhara rāẏa,
khelite khelite pathe |
jananī dekhiẏā, āila dhāiẏā,
ki laiẏā yāo hāte || 360 ||

henai samaya — at that very time; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; khelite khelite pathe — playing on the road; janani dekhiya — seeing His mother; aila dhaiya — came running; ki laiya yao hate — what are you carrying in your hands

360At that very moment Vishvambhara Raya,
playing on the road,
saw His mother and came running:
"What are you carrying in your hands?"

বাহু পসারিয়া, পথ আগুলিয়া,
জননী রাখিতে চায় ।
কি কি বলি মায়, ধরিবারে চায়,
আখটি করিয়া মায় ॥ ৩৬১ ॥

bāhu pasāriẏā, patha āguliẏā,
jananī rākhite cāẏa |
ki ki bali māẏa, dharibāre cāẏa,
ākhaṭi kariẏā māẏa || 361 ||

bahu pasariya — spreading His arms; patha aguliya — blocking the way; janani rakhite chaya — wants to stop His mother; ki ki bali maya — saying "what, what" to His mother; dharibare chaya — wants to grab; akhati kariya maya — fretting at His mother

361Spreading His arms, blocking the way,
He tries to stop His mother;
"What is it, what?" He keeps saying and tries to grab it,
fretting before His mother.

দেব-আরাধনে, করিয়া যতনে,
লইয়া নৈবেদ্যখানি ।
ষষ্ঠী পূজিবারে, যাই বটতলে,
এইখানে খেল তুমি ॥ ৩৬২ ॥

deba-ārādhane, kariẏā yatane,
laiẏā naibedyakhāni |
ṣaṣṭhī pūjibāre, yāi baṭatale,
eikhāne khela tumi || 362 ||

deva-aradhane — for the worship of the goddess; kariya yatane — carefully prepared; laiya naivedyakhani — taking the offering; shashthi pujibare — to worship Shashthi; yai vatatale — I am going to the banyan; eikhane khela tumi — You play here

362"I have carefully prepared the offering
for the worship of the goddess,
and I am going to the banyan to worship Shashthi —
You play here.

আসিবার বেলে, প্রসাদ তোমারে,
আনি দিব শুন বাপ ।
দেবতা পূজিব, এ বর মাগিব,
ঘুচিব অমঙ্গল-তাপ ॥ ৩৬৩ ॥

āsibāra bele, prasāda tomāre,
āni diba śuna bāpa |
debatā pūjiba, e bara māgiba,
ghuciba amaṅgala-tāpa || 363 ||

asibara bele — on the way back; prasada tomare ani diba — I will bring You prasada; shuna bapa — listen, child; devata pujiba — I will worship the goddess; e vara magiba — I will ask this boon; ghuchiba amangala-tapa — the fever of misfortune will go

363On my way back, listen, child,
I will bring You prasada;
I will worship the goddess and ask her for this boon —
that the fever of misfortune may go."

এতেক উত্তর, জননী-অন্তর,
জানিঞা শ্রীবিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহে লহু বাণী, অমিয়া লাবণি,
মুখে মিলাইছে তার ॥ ৩৬৪ ॥

eteka uttara, jananī-antara,
jāniñā śrībiśbambhara |
kahe lahu bāṇī, amiẏā lābaṇi,
mukhe milāiche tāra || 364 ||

eteka uttara — such a reply; janani-antara janina — knowing His mother's heart; shri-vishvambhara — Sri Vishvambhara; kahe lahu vani — speaks gentle words; amiya lavani — nectarean loveliness; mukhe milaichhe tara — spreads over His lips

364Hearing such a reply and knowing His mother's heart,
Sri Vishvambhara
speaks gentle words —
a nectarean loveliness spreads over His lips:

এই মতে তোরে, বোলোঁ বারে বারে,
না বুঝসি অবোধিনি ।
ক্ষুধায় আমার, পোড়য়ে অন্তর,
নৈবেদ্য খাইব আমি ॥ ৩৬৫ ॥

ei mate tore, boloṁ bāre bāre,
nā bujhasi abodhini |
kṣudhāẏa āmāra, poṛaẏe antara,
naibedya khāiba āmi || 365 ||

ei mate tore — thus to you; bolon bare bare — I say again and again; na bujhasi abodhini — you don't understand, foolish one; kshudhaya amara — with hunger My; podaye antara — insides burn; naivedya khaiba ami — I will eat the offering

365"How many times have I told you —
you don't understand, foolish one!
With hunger
I am burning inside: I will eat the offering."

ইহা বলি ধরি, সেই গৌরহরি,
নৈবেদ্য ভরিল মুখে ।
দেখিয়া জননী, হাহাকার-বাণী,
অন্তর জ্বলিল দুঃখে ॥ ৩৬৬ ॥

ihā bali dhari, sei gaurahari,
naibedya bharila mukhe |
dekhiẏā jananī, hāhākāra-bāṇī,
antara jbalila duḥkhe || 366 ||

iha bali dhari — saying this, seizing; sei gaurahari — Gaurahari; naivedya bharila mukhe — filled His mouth with the offering; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; hahakara-vani — cried out in dismay; antara jvalila duhkhe — her heart burned with grief

366Saying this, Gaurahari seized
the offering and filled His mouth with it;
seeing it, His mother cried out in dismay —
her heart blazed with grief.

দেবতার দ্রব্য, ঘৃত মধু গব্য,
বিশ্বম্ভর খাইল দেখি ।
শচীর অন্তরে, ধক ধক করে,
কোপে ছলছল আঁখি ॥ ৩৬৭ ॥

debatāra drabya, ghṛta madhu gabya,
biśbambhara khāila dekhi |
śacīra antare, dhaka dhaka kare,
kope chalachala āṁkhi || 367 ||

devatara dravya — the goddess's articles; ghrita madhu gavya — ghee, honey, milk-foods; vishvambhara khaila dekhi — seeing that Vishvambhara ate; shachira antare — in Shachi's breast; dhaka dhaka kare — it pounds; kope chhalachhala ankhi — eyes brimming with angry tears

367Seeing that Vishvambhara had eaten what was meant for the goddess —
ghee, honey, milk-foods —
Shachi, her heart pounding,
her eyes brimming with angry tears, [says]:

অবোধিয়া পুত, বুঝাইব কত,
দেবতা না মান তুমি ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-কুমার, হঞা দুরাচার,
এ দুঃখে মরিব আমি ॥ ৩৬৮ ॥

abodhiẏā puta, bujhāiba kata,
debatā nā māna tumi |
brāhmaṇa-kumāra, hañā durācāra,
e duḥkhe mariba āmi || 368 ||

abodhiya puta — silly child; bujhaiba kata — how much shall I teach; devata na mana tumi — You do not honour the gods; brahmana-kumara hana — being a brahmana's son; durachara — ill-behaved; e duhkhe mariba ami — I shall die of this grief

368"Silly child, how much must I teach You!
You do not honour the gods.
A brahmana's son — and so ill-behaved!
I shall die of this grief."

শুনি গৌরমণি, জননীর বাণী,
অন্তর জ্বলিল কোপে ।
কহিল এ সব, না বুঝসি তব,
কুবোল বোলসি মোকে ॥ ৩৬৯ ॥

śuni gauramaṇi, jananīra bāṇī,
antara jbalila kope |
kahila e saba, nā bujhasi taba,
kubola bolasi moke || 369 ||

shuni gauramani — hearing, the jewel Gaura; jananira vani — His mother's words; antara jvalila kope — blazed with anger within; kahila e saba — I told all this; na bujhasi taba — still you don't understand; kubola bolasi moke — you speak ill words to Me

369Hearing His mother's words,
the jewel Gaura blazed with anger:
"I told you all this — and still you do not understand
and speak ill words to Me.

শুন অবোধিনি, আমি সব জানি,
আমি তিনলোক-সার ।
জগতে যতেক, আমি মাত্র এক,
ত্রিভুবনে নাহি আর ॥ ৩৭০ ॥

śuna abodhini, āmi saba jāni,
āmi tinaloka-sāra |
jagate yateka, āmi mātra eka,
tribhubane nāhi āra || 370 ||

shuna abodhini — listen, foolish one; ami saba jani — I know everything; ami tinaloka-sara — I am the essence of the three worlds; jagate yateka — whatever is in the world; ami matra eka — I alone; tribhuvane nahi ara — in the three worlds there is no other

370Listen, foolish one: I know everything,
I am the essence of the three worlds;
whatever there is in the world is I alone,
in the three worlds there is no other.5

তরুমূলে যেন, জল-নিষেচন,
উপরে সিঞ্চিত শাখা ।
প্রাণ-নিষেবণ, ইন্দ্রিয় যেমন,
এছন আমার লেখা ॥ ৩৭১ ॥

tarumūle yena, jala-niṣecana,
upare siñcita śākhā |
prāṇa-niṣebaṇa, indriẏa yemana,
echana āmāra lekhā || 371 ||

tarumule yena — as at the root of a tree; jala-nishechana — the pouring of water; upare sinchita shakha — [and] the branches above are watered; prana-nishevana — nourishing the prana; indriya yemana — as [satisfies] the senses; echhana amara lekha — such is the law concerning Me

371As watering the root of a tree
nourishes the branches above,
as nourishing the life-breath (prana) [satisfies] the senses —
such is the law concerning Me."

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (4.31.14):

যথা তরোর্মূলনিষেচনেন তৃপ্যন্তি তৎস্কন্ধভুজোপশাখাঃ ।
প্রাণোপহারাচ্চ যথেন্দ্রিয়াণাং তথৈব সর্বার্হণমচ্যুতেজ্যা ॥

yathā tarormūlaniṣecanena tṛpyanti tatskandhabhujopaśākhāḥ |
prāṇopahārācca yathendriẏāṇāṃ tathaiba sarbārhaṇamacyutejyā ||

yatha — as; taroh — of a tree; mula-nishechanena — by watering the root; tripyanti — are satisfied; tat-skandha-bhuja-upashakhah — its trunk, branches and twigs; prana-upaharat — by offering [food] to the prana; cha — and; yatha — as; indriyanam — of the senses; tatha eva — just so; sarva-arhanam — the worship of all; achyuta-ijya — the worship of Achyuta

371a"As by watering the root of a tree its trunk, branches and twigs are satisfied,
and as by food offered to the prana the senses [are satisfied] —
so worship of Achyuta is the worship of all."6

ইহা বলি হরি, করিয়া চাতুরী,
মায়ের গলায় ধরে ।
শচীর হৃদয়, অতি সবিস্ময়,
গেলা ষষ্ঠী পূজিবারে ॥ ৩৭২ ॥

ihā bali hari, kariẏā cāturī,
māẏera galāẏa dhare |
śacīra hṛdaẏa, ati sabismaẏa,
gelā ṣaṣṭhī pūjibāre || 372 ||

iha bali hari — saying this, Hari; kariya chaturi — playfully (lit. "showing cleverness"); mayera galaya dhare — clasps His mother's neck; shachira hridaya ati savismaya — Shachi, astonished at heart; gela shashthi pujibare — went to worship Shashthi

372Saying this, Hari playfully
put His arms round His mother's neck;
and Shachi, astonished at heart,
went to worship Shashthi.

সেই ষষ্ঠীদেবী, বহুবিধ সেবি,
বোলয়ে কাতর-বাণী ।
আমার ছাওয়াল, বড়ই ধামাল,
দোষ ক্ষেমিবে আপনি ॥ ৩৭৩ ॥

sei ṣaṣṭhīdebī, bahubidha sebi,
bolaẏe kātara-bāṇī |
āmāra chāoẏāla, baṛai dhāmāla,
doṣa kṣemibe āpani || 373 ||

sei shashthidevi — the goddess Shashthi; bahuvidha sevi — having served in many ways; bolaye katara-vani — speaks plaintively; amara chhaoyala — my child; badai dhamala — is a great rascal; dosha kshemibe apani — please forgive the fault

373Having served the goddess Shashthi in many ways,
she speaks plaintively:
"My child is a great rascal;
please forgive His fault.

তুমি দিলে মোরে, এ ক্ষেপা কোঁয়রে,
কেমনে লইবে দোষ ।
করিবে কল্যাণ, এ মোর নন্দন,
না করিহ কিছু রোষ ॥ ৩৭৪ ॥

tumi dile more, e kṣepā koṁẏare,
kemane laibe doṣa |
karibe kalyāṇa, e mora nandana,
nā kariha kichu roṣa || 374 ||

tumi dile more — you gave me; e kshepa konyare — this wild boy; kemane laibe dosha — how can you take offence; karibe kalyana — grant blessing; e mora nandana — to this son of mine; na kariha kichhu rosha — do not be angry at all

374You yourself gave me this wild boy —
how can you take offence at Him?
Grant your blessing to this son of mine,
do not be angry at all.

সাত পাঁচ নাই, এ ধন নিমাই,
দিলে গো করুণা করি ।
বিঘ্ন নাহি হয়, এ মোর তনয়,
এ বালক দেবি তোরি ॥ ৩৭৫ ॥

sāta pāṁca nāi, e dhana nimāi,
dile go karuṇā kari |
bighna nāhi haẏa, e mora tanaẏa,
e bālaka debi tori || 375 ||

sata pancha nai — I have not many; e dhana nimai — this treasure Nimai; dile go karuna kari — you gave out of mercy; vighna nahi haya — let no misfortune be; e mora tanaya — to this son of mine; e balaka devi tori — this boy is yours, O goddess

375I have not many — this treasure Nimai
you gave me out of mercy;
let no misfortune befall my son —
this boy is yours, O goddess!"

এতেক বলিয়া, চরণে পড়িয়া,
যত বৃদ্ধ নারীগণে ।
বলয়ে বিনতি, করিয়া প্রণতি,
আশীর্বাদ কর মনে ॥ ৩৭৬ ॥

eteka baliẏā, caraṇe paṛiẏā,
yata bṛddha nārīgaṇe |
balaẏe binati, kariẏā praṇati,
āśīrbāda kara mane || 376 ||

eteka baliya — saying this; charane padiya — falling at the feet; yata vriddha narigane — of all the elderly women; balaye vinati — humbly entreats; kariya pranati — bowing; ashirvada kara mane — bless [Him] at heart

376Saying this, she falls at the feet
of all the elderly women,
humbly entreats them and bows:
"Bless Him from your hearts!

চরণের ধূলি, দেহ নিজ বলি,
মোর বিশ্বম্ভর-শিরে ।
এ মোর ছাওয়াল, বড়ই চঞ্চল,
বুদ্ধি হয় যেন স্থিরে ॥ ৩৭৭ ॥

caraṇera dhūli, deha nija bali,
mora biśbambhara-śire |
e mora chāoẏāla, baṛai cañcala,
buddhi haẏa yena sthire || 377 ||

charanera dhuli — the dust of your feet; deha nija bali — give, calling Him your own; mora vishvambhara-shire — on my Vishvambhara's head; e mora chhaoyala — this child of mine; badai chanchala — is very restless; buddhi haya yena sthire — may His mind become steady

377Calling [Him] your own, place the dust of your feet
on the head of my Vishvambhara;
this child of mine is very restless —
may His mind become steady."

দন্তে তৃণ ধরি, বোলে শচীরাণী,
সভার চরণ সেবি ।
সভে দেহ বর, মোর বিশ্বম্ভর,
পুত্র হউ চিরজীবী ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

dante tṛṇa dhari, bole śacīrāṇī,
sabhāra caraṇa sebi |
sabhe deha bara, mora biśbambhara,
putra hau cirajībī || 378 ||

dante trina dhari — holding grass between her teeth; bole shachirani — Shachi-rani says; sabhara charana sevi — serving the feet of all; sabhe deha vara — all give a blessing; mora vishvambhara putra — my son Vishvambhara; hau chirajivi — may He live long

378Holding a blade of grass between her teeth,7 Shachi-rani says,
serving the feet of all:
"Bless Him, all of you — may my son Vishvambhara
live long!"

ষষ্ঠীপূজা করি, পুত্র করে ধরি,
ঘরেরে চলিলা দেবী ।
জগন্নাথ-সনে, করে অনুমানে,
মনে অনুভব ভাবি ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

ṣaṣṭhīpūjā kari, putra kare dhari,
gharere calilā debī |
jagannātha-sane, kare anumāne,
mane anubhaba bhābi || 379 ||

shashthi-puja kari — having worshipped Shashthi; putra kare dhari — taking her son by the hand; gharere chalila devi — the goddess went home; jagannatha-sane — with Jagannatha; kare anumane — reflects; mane anubhava bhavi — pondering her experience

379Having performed the worship of Shashthi and taking her son by the hand,
the goddess went home;
with Jagannatha she reflects,
pondering what she had experienced.

কি কহিব আর, সর্বদেব-সার,
পৃথিবীতে পরকাশ ।
বালকের সঙ্গে, খেলে নানা রঙ্গে,
কহয়ে লোচনদাস ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

ki kahiba āra, sarbadeba-sāra,
pṛthibīte parakāśa |
bālakera saṅge, khele nānā raṅge,
kahaẏe locanadāsa || 380 ||

ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; sarvadeva-sara — the essence of all the gods; prithivite parakasha — manifest on earth; balakera sange — with the boys; khele nana range — plays in many ways; kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa

380What more shall I say? The essence of all the gods
has appeared on earth
and plays with the boys in many ways —
says Lochana Dasa.

Raga varadi8

তবে আর কথোদিনে, সেই শচীনন্দনে,
ধূলায় খেলায় রাজপথে ।
এ ধূলি-ধূসর, হেমগিরি-কলেবর,
অনুগত বয়স্য-সহিতে ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

tabe āra kathodine, sei śacīnandane,
dhūlāẏa khelāẏa rājapathe |
e dhūli-dhūsara, hemagiri-kalebara,
anugata baẏasya-sahite || 381 ||

tabe ara kathodine — then some days later; sei shachinandane — that son of Shachi; dhulaya khelaya rajapathe — plays in the dust on the highway; e dhuli-dhusara — grey with dust; hemagiri-kalevara — His body a golden mountain; anugata vayasya-sahite — with devoted companions

381And some days later that son of Shachi
plays in the dust on the highway;
His body a golden mountain, grey with dust,
with Him His devoted companions.

শিশু শিশু ধূলা খেলি, ক্ষণে হয় গালাগালি,
ধূলা-রণে অঙ্গ দিগম্বাস ।
সমান সে বয়ঃক্রম, সভে মেলি একমর্ম,
ঘর্মবিন্দু খেলায় আয়াস ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

śiśu śiśu dhūlā kheli, kṣaṇe haẏa gālāgāli,
dhūlā-raṇe aṅga digambāsa |
samāna se baẏaḥkrama, sabhe meli ekamarma,
gharmabindu khelāẏa āẏāsa || 382 ||

shishu shishu dhula kheli — children playing with dust; kshane haya galagali — now and then squabble; dhula-rane — in the dust-battle; anga digambasa — bodies bare; samana se vayahkrama — all of one age; sabhe meli eka-marma — all of one mind; gharma-bindu khelaya ayasa — sweat-drops from the effort of play

382The children play with dust, now and then they squabble,
in the dust-battle their bodies are bare;
all of one age, all of one mind,
drops of sweat from the effort of play.

সভে মেলি খেলা খেলে, গুপ্ত-বেজা হেনকালে,
সেই পথে আইলা আচম্বিত ।
তার যত নিজজন, সঙ্গে করে গমন,
জ্ঞানপথ-বিচারে পণ্ডিত ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

sabhe meli khelā khele, gupta-bejā henakāle,
sei pathe āilā ācambita |
tāra yata nijajana, saṅge kare gamana,
jñānapatha-bicāre paṇḍita || 383 ||

sabhe meli khela khele — while all were playing together; gupta-beja henakale — then Gupta the vaidya; sei pathe aila achambita — suddenly came that way; tara yata nijajana — all his own people; sange kare gamana — go with him; jnanapatha-vichare pandita — a scholar in discussing the path of knowledge

383While they were all playing together, Gupta the vaidya9
suddenly came along that road;
all his own people went with him,
and he, a scholar, was discoursing on the path of knowledge.

তার সনে অনুমানে, যোগশাস্ত্র বাখানে,
কর শির করিয়া চালন ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর রায়, তার পাছে পাছে ধায়,
অনুসরি গমন বচন ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

tāra sane anumāne, yogaśāstra bākhāne,
kara śira kariẏā cālana |
dekhi biśbambhara rāẏa, tāra pāche pāche dhāẏa,
anusari gamana bacana || 384 ||

tara sane anumane — reasoning with them; yogashastra vakhane — expounds the yoga-shastra; kara shira kariya chalana — moving hands and head; dekhi vishvambhara raya — seeing, Vishvambhara Raya; tara pachhe pachhe dhaya — runs right behind him; anusari gamana vachana — imitating his gait and speech

384Reasoning with them, he expounds the yoga-shastra,
shaking his head and waving his hands;
seeing this, Vishvambhara Raya runs right behind him,
imitating his gait and speech.

দেখি বৈদ্য মুরারি, কটাক্ষে তিলেক হেরি,
পুনঃ করে যোগের বাখান ।
সেইমতে বিশ্বম্ভর, যোগের বাখান করে,
তেন নাড়ে হাথ মুখখান ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

dekhi baidya murāri, kaṭākṣe tileka heri,
punaḥ kare yogera bākhāna |
seimate biśbambhara, yogera bākhāna kare,
tena nāṛe hātha mukhakhāna || 385 ||

dekhi vaidya murari — seeing, Murari the vaidya; katakshe tileka heri — glancing sidelong for a moment; punah kare yogera vakhana — again expounds yoga; sei-mate vishvambhara — just so Vishvambhara; yogera vakhana kare — expounds yoga; tena nade hatha mukhakhana — just so moves His hands and face

385Murari the vaidya, glancing [at Him] for a moment,
again expounds yoga;
just so Vishvambhara expounds yoga,
just so He moves His hands and head.

এইমতে বেরি বেরি, পরিহাসে গৌরহরি,
শিশুগণ সংহতি করিয়া ।
দেখিয়া মুরারি বৈদ্য, নিজ আচরণে গদ্য,
কুবচন কহিল রুষিয়া ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

eimate beri beri, parihāse gaurahari,
śiśugaṇa saṃhati kariẏā |
dekhiẏā murāri baidya, nija ācaraṇe gadya,
kubacana kahila ruṣiẏā || 386 ||

ei-mate beri beri — thus again and again; parihase gaurahari — Gaurahari mimics; shishugana samhati kariya — together with the children; dekhiya murari vaidya — seeing, Murari the vaidya; nija acharane gadya — [his] own manners mimicked; kuvachana kahila rushiya — angrily spoke rude words

386So again and again Gaurahari
mimics him together with the children;
Murari the vaidya, seeing his own manners mimicked,
grew angry and spoke rude words:

এছারে কে বলে ভাল, দেখিল ত ছাওয়াল,
মিশ্র-পুরন্দর-সুত এই ।
সর্বত্র শুনিয়ে কথা, ইহার সে গুণগাথা,
ভাল নাম ইহার নিমাই ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

echāre ke bale bhāla, dekhila ta chāoẏāla,
miśra-purandara-suta ei |
sarbatra śuniẏe kathā, ihāra se guṇagāthā,
bhāla nāma ihāra nimāi || 387 ||

echhare ke bale bhala — who calls this one good; dekhila ta chhaoyala — I've seen the boy; mishra-purandara-suta ei — this is Mishra Purandara's son; sarvatra shuniye katha — everywhere I hear talk; ihara se gunagatha — the songs of his virtues; bhala nama ihara nimai — a fine name he has, Nimai

387"Who would call this one good? I've seen the boy —
this is Mishra Purandara's son;
everywhere I hear talk and songs of his virtues —
a fine name he has: Nimai!"10

ঐছন শুনিয়া বাণী, রুষিলা সে গৌরমণি,
অনুগত-কৃপার কারণে ।
ভ্রুকুটি বদন করি, বোলে বাক্-চাতুরী,
জানাইব ভোজনের ক্ষণে ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

aichana śuniẏā bāṇī, ruṣilā se gauramaṇi,
anugata-kṛpāra kāraṇe |
bhrukuṭi badana kari, bole bāk-cāturī,
jānāiba bhojanera kṣaṇe || 388 ||

aichhana shuniya vani — hearing such words; rushila se gauramani — the jewel Gaura grew angry; anugata-kripara karane — for the sake of mercy to His devotee; bhrukuti badana kari — frowning; bole vak-chaturi — speaks teasingly (lit. "with cleverness of speech"); janaiba bhojanera kshane — I'll let you know at mealtime

388Hearing such words, the jewel Gaura grew angry —
for the sake of mercy to His devotee;
frowning, He says teasingly:
"You'll find out at mealtime!"11

শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর-বাণী, মুরারি সে মনে গুণি,
ঘর গেলা বিস্মিত-হিয়ায় ।
গৃহকার্য-ব্যাপৃতে, পাসরিল আন-চিতে,
হৈল তবে ভোজন-সময় ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

śuni biśbambhara-bāṇī, murāri se mane guṇi,
ghara gelā bismita-hiẏāẏa |
gṛhakārya-byāpṛte, pāsarila āna-cite,
haila tabe bhojana-samaẏa || 389 ||

shuni vishvambhara-vani — hearing Vishvambhara's words; murari se mane guni — Murari pondered; ghara gela vismita-hiyay — went home with a wondering heart; griha-karya-vyaprite — busy with household tasks; pasarila ana-chite — forgot, his mind elsewhere; haila tabe bhojana-samaya — then came mealtime

389Hearing Vishvambhara's words, Murari pondered
and went home with a wondering heart;
busy with household affairs, his mind turned elsewhere and he forgot,
and then it was time to eat.

এথা বিশ্বম্ভর হরি, অঙ্গের সুবেশ করি,
কটিতে টানিঞা পিন্ধে ধড়া ।
শিরে শোভে তিন ঝুঁটি, গলায়ে সে রসকাঁটি,
কণ্ঠলগ্ন মুকুতা দুবেড়া ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

ethā biśbambhara hari, aṅgera subeśa kari,
kaṭite ṭāniñā pindhe dhaṛā |
śire śobhe tina jhuṁṭi, galāẏe se rasakāṁṭi,
kaṇṭhalagna mukutā dubeṛā || 390 ||

etha vishvambhara hari — meanwhile Vishvambhara Hari; angera subesha kari — dressing finely; katite tanina pindhe dhada — wraps the dhoti tightly round His waist; shire shobhe tina jhunti — three tufts adorn His head; galaye se rasakanti — rasakanti beads on His neck; kantha-lagna mukuta dubeda — a double pearl string at the throat

390Meanwhile Vishvambhara Hari dressed Himself finely:
He wrapped His dhoti tightly round His waist,
three tufts adorn His head, rasakanti beads hang on His neck,
a double string of pearls at His throat.

নয়নে কাজর-রেখা, পাঁচথুপী বান্ধে শিখা,
ঝলমল হেম-অলঙ্কার ।
চরণে মগরা খাড়ু, হাথে করি ক্ষীর-লাড়ু,
চলিলা ঠাকুর বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

naẏane kājara-rekhā, pāṁcathupī bāndhe śikhā,
jhalamala hema-alaṅkāra |
caraṇe magarā khāṛu, hāthe kari kṣīra-lāṛu,
calilā ṭhākura biśbambhara || 391 ||

nayane kajara-rekha — a line of kajal in the eyes; pancha-thupi bandhe shikha — topknot tied with five knots; jhalamala hema-alankara — golden ornaments glitter; charane magara khadu — magara anklets on the feet; hathe kari kshira-ladu — holding a milk laddu in hand; chalila thakura vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara set out

391A line of kajal in His eyes, His topknot tied with five knots,
golden ornaments glittering,
magara anklets on His feet; holding a milk laddu in His hand,
the Lord Vishvambhara set out.

মুরারি গুপ্তের ঘরে, গেলা নিজ অভ্যন্তরে,
ভোজন করিছে বৈদ্যরাজ ।
মেঘগম্ভীর-নাদে, নিজ মন-পরসাদে,
মুরারি বলিয়া দিলা ডাক ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

murāri guptera ghare, gelā nija abhyantare,
bhojana kariche baidyarāja |
meghagambhīra-nāde, nija mana-parasāde,
murāri baliẏā dilā ḍāka || 392 ||

murari guptera ghare — in Murari Gupta's house; gela nija abhyantare — went into the inner rooms; bhojana karichhe vaidyaraja — where the king of vaidyas was eating; megha-gambhira-nade — in a voice deep as thunder; nija-mana-parasade — by His own grace; murari baliya dila daka — called "Murari!"

392He entered Murari Gupta's house, into the inner rooms,
where the best of vaidyas was eating his meal,
and in a voice deep as thunder, by His own grace,
He called: "Murari!"

স্বর শুনি সোঙরিল, বিশ্বম্ভর যে বলিল,
গুপ্ত-বেজা চমকিত চিত ।
তবে সেই গৌরহরি, কি কর কি কর বলি,
সেইখানে হৈল উপনীত ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

sbara śuni soṅarila, biśbambhara ye balila,
gupta-bejā camakita cita |
tabe sei gaurahari, ki kara ki kara bali,
seikhāne haila upanīta || 393 ||

svara shuni songarila — hearing the voice, he remembered; vishvambhara ye balila — what Vishvambhara had said; gupta-beja chamakita chita — Gupta the vaidya was startled; tabe sei gaurahari — then Gaurahari; ki kara ki kara bali — saying "what are you doing, what are you doing"; seikhane haila upanita — came right up there

393Hearing the voice, Gupta the vaidya remembered
what Vishvambhara had said, and was startled;
and Gaurahari, saying "What are you doing, what are you doing?",
came right up to the spot.

তরস্ত না হও তুমি, এইখানে আছি আমি,
ভোজন করহ বাণী বৈল ।
মধ্য-ভোজন-বেলা, ধীরে ধীরে নিয়ড়ে গেলা,
থাল ভরি মূত মুতিলা ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

tarasta nā hao tumi, eikhāne āchi āmi,
bhojana karaha bāṇī baila |
madhya-bhojana-belā, dhīre dhīre niẏaṛe gelā,
thāla bhari mūta mutilā || 394 ||

tarasta na hao tumi — don't be alarmed; eikhane achhi ami — I am here; bhojana karaha — go on eating; vani baila — He said; madhya-bhojana-bela — in the middle of the meal; dhire dhire niyade gela — slowly came close; thala bhari muta mutila — urinated, filling the plate

394"Don't be alarmed: I am here —
go on eating," He said;
and in the middle of the meal, approaching very slowly,
He filled his plate with urine.

কি কি বলি ছি ছি করি, উঠিলা সে মুরারি,
করতালি দিয়া বোলে গোরা ।
কর শির নাড়িয়া, ভক্তিপথ ছাড়িয়া,
যোগ বলে এই অভিপারী ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

ki ki bali chi chi kari, uṭhilā se murāri,
karatāli diẏā bole gorā |
kara śira nāṛiẏā, bhaktipatha chāṛiẏā,
yoga bale ei abhipārī || 395 ||

ki ki bali — crying "what, what"; chhi chhi kari — saying "shame, shame"; uthila se murari — Murari jumped up; karatali diya — clapping His hands; bole gora — Gora says; kara shira nadiya — moving hands and head; bhaktipatha chhadiya — having left the path of bhakti; yoga bale ei abhipari — this trickster speaks of yoga

395"What's this, what?! Shame, shame!" — up jumped Murari;
and Gora, clapping His hands, says:
"Shaking his head and waving his hands, having left the path of bhakti,
this trickster expounds yoga!

জ্ঞান-কর্ম উপেখিয়া, কৃষ্ণ ভজ মন দিয়া,
রসিক বিদগ্ধ চিদানন্দ ।
ভৌতিকে যাহার দৃষ্টি, এ নহে ভজন-পুষ্টি,
নাহি বুঝ বুদ্ধি অতি মন্দ ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

jñāna-karma upekhiẏā, kṛṣṇa bhaja mana diẏā,
rasika bidagdha cidānanda |
bhautike yāhāra dṛṣṭi, e nahe bhajana-puṣṭi,
nāhi bujha buddhi ati manda || 396 ||

jnana-karma upekhiya — disregarding knowledge and ritual; krishna bhaja mana diya — worship Krishna wholeheartedly; rasika vidagdha chidananda — the relisher of rasa, expert, consciousness and bliss; bhautike yahara drishti — one whose sight is on the material; e nahe bhajana-pushti — has no nourishment of bhajana; nahi bujha — you don't understand; buddhi ati manda — intelligence very dull

396Disregarding knowledge and ritual, worship Krishna wholeheartedly —
the relisher of rasa, the expert, full of consciousness and bliss.
One whose sight is fixed on the material finds no nourishment for bhajana;
you do not understand — your intelligence is very dull.

পরম দয়ালু হরি, তেঁহো সর্বশক্তিধারী,
জীবেতে সম্ভবে এ কি কথা ।
তেঁহো ব্রহ্ম সনাতন, গোপীর জীবন-ধন,
না ভজিয়া কেনে দেহ ব্যথা ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

parama daẏālu hari, teṁho sarbaśaktidhārī,
jībete sambhabe e ki kathā |
teṁho brahma sanātana, gopīra jībana-dhana,
nā bhajiẏā kene deha byathā || 397 ||

parama dayalu hari — Hari is supremely merciful; tenho sarva-shakti-dhari — He holds all energies; jivete sambhave e ki katha — is such a thing possible for a jiva; tenho brahma sanatana — He is the eternal Brahman; gopira jivana-dhana — the treasure of the gopis' life; na bhajiya — not worshipping [Him]; kene deha vyatha — why cause pain

397Hari is supremely merciful, He holds all energies;
is such a thing possible for a jiva?12
He is the eternal Brahman, the treasure of the gopis' life;
why, not worshipping Him, do you cause [yourself] pain?"

ইহা বলি গোরামণি, কতি গেলা নাহি জানি,
মুরারি দেখিতে নাহি পায় ।
মনে মনে অনুমান, এ কভু নহে আন,
সত্য পঁহু শচীর তনয় ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

ihā bali gorāmaṇi, kati gelā nāhi jāni,
murāri dekhite nāhi pāẏa |
mane mane anumāna, e kabhu nahe āna,
satya paṁhu śacīra tanaẏa || 398 ||

iha bali goramani — saying this, the jewel Gora; kati gela nahi jani — went none knows where; murari dekhite nahi paya — Murari cannot see; mane mane anumana — reflects within; e kabhu nahe ana — this is surely no other; satya panhu shachira tanaya — truly Shachi's son is the Lord

398Saying this, the jewel Gaura vanished — none knows where;
Murari cannot see Him
and reflects within himself: "This is surely no one else —
truly, the son of Shachi is the Lord."

এত অনুমান করি, তবে সেই মুরারি,
আস্তে ব্যস্তে চলিলা সত্বর ।
চলিতে না পারে পথে, অতি আনন্দিত চিতে,
গেলা যথা মিশ্র পুরন্দর ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

eta anumāna kari, tabe sei murāri,
āste byaste calilā satbara |
calite nā pāre pathe, ati ānandita cite,
gelā yathā miśra purandara || 399 ||

eta anumana kari — having reflected thus; tabe sei murari — then Murari; aste vyaste chalila satvara — hastily set out in agitation; chalite na pare pathe — cannot walk on the road; ati anandita chite — with a heart full of joy; gela yatha mishra purandara — went to where Mishra Purandara was

399Having reflected thus, Murari
set out at once, in haste and agitation;
from great joy he can hardly walk on the road,
[yet] he came to where Mishra Purandara was.

✦

Notes

  1. In the 1903 edition the whole account of the puppy's deliverance (vv. 324–357) is enclosed in brackets — this editor's way of marking lines found not in all manuscripts. In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary the puppy "in a divine body, singing of Hari, went to Vaikuntha"; the text says Goloka ("becoming a dweller of Krishna's realm"; the 1983 edition: "of Vishnu's realm"). Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Antya 1.16–33): Shivananda Sena's dog, having received the remnants of Mahaprabhu's meal and chanting "Krishna", attained Vaikuntha.
  2. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the numbering jumps here from 330 to 340; we keep the edition's numbers.
  3. That is, even Krishna in His earlier pastimes did not bestow mercy so freely. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 19.53): Gaura is "the most magnanimous", the giver of prema for Krishna.
  4. Shashthi — the goddess who protects children; women honour her with fasting and offerings under a banyan tree for the welfare of their children.
  5. This is not an assertion of impersonal oneness: all that exists is the energy of the Lord and does not exist apart from Him, while He remains the personal Lord. Cf. the Bhagavata (2.9.33): "Before creation I alone existed…", and Mahaprabhu's teaching of inconceivable oneness and difference (achintya-bhedabheda). This is the sense the following shloka brings out.
  6. In the edition the shloka is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation (the OCR is almost illegible); the translation runs: "As watering the root of a tree satisfies its trunk, branches, twigs and so on, and as food offered to the prana satisfies all the senses, so by worshipping Achyuta alone all the gods are worshipped." In the 1903 edition the shloka is given in square brackets as an editorial insertion.
  7. A blade of grass between the teeth is a sign of utmost humility before those whose favour is asked.
  8. In A the raga line is corrupt; "varadi" follows the 1983 edition.
  9. Murari Gupta, a vaidya (physician) by caste, later one of Mahaprabhu's closest associates and author of the Sanskrit biography Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita. Here he is still devoted to yoga and the path of knowledge.
  10. A gibe: "Nimai" comes from the bitter neem tree (see en/09, note 12).
  11. Lochana Dasa stresses that the Lord's "anger" is mercy: He breaks Murari's attachment to dry yoga and knowledge so as to turn him to bhakti.
  12. That is, the perfections of which yoga speaks are attributes of the Lord; the jiva cannot acquire them by its own efforts — its path is service to Him.
